notes.title: CLCB Update v0.2.2
notes.notes:
Hi all, glad to announce the next content update is finally out. This update is primarily focused on expanding the game’s stat tracking features, along with a few performance improvements and minor bug fixes. Details below:

Major Features:

Historical stat tracking. You are now able to see player and team stats from all historical seasons, with career/all-time totals available as well. Player stat history is partially backward compatible for pre-update saves, team stat history will begin being tracked with this update. To note: when viewing career/all-time stats by conference, only the seasons a player or team spent in that conference are included.

Player stats can now be viewed in the per-game, per 40 minutes, or totals format.

Stat filters. The player and team stats pages now include a filtering feature.

New bracketology update articles are now automatically generated after game days 1, 15, and 30.

Alumni player pages. Former players now have their own profile pages, which show their accomplishments and stats.

Bug Fixes & Tweaks:

Made conference prestige caps slightly less restrictive.

Improved load times between offseason stages.

Improved performance on the class ranking page.

Fixed a bug where the date on the progress bar popup wasn’t updating during multi-game simulations.

Fixed scroll sensitivity being too low on the team history panel.

Updated the default database start year to the 2025–26 season.

notes.title: CLCB v0.2.1 Patch 1
notes.notes:
Quick patch today focused on polish, UI tweaks, and a handful of bug fixes. Changes listed below:

Bug Fixes & Tweaks:
- Transfer players now display their numeric ratings directly on the recruit dropdown prior to committing (previously required clicking into their profile).
- Game log load times have been significantly improved. Load times for the training reports page and league news hub were also improved somewhat.
- Fixed an issue where conference logos didn’t update immediately after selecting a new logo pack in-game.
- Conference logos have been added to the header of the conference standings page.
- Two new player hairstyles (long shag and headband dreads) added, along with various minor player art improvements.
- Fixed a bug where players could begin simulating games without advancing past the season preview via the Speed Sim menu.
- Added further protections against a bug that could require clicking an option in the Speed Sim menu multiple times to initiate simulation (let me know if anyone is still dealing with this post-patch).
- Fixed a bug where broken tournament bracket game logs could be accessed during recruiting.

notes.title: CLCB Update v0.2.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! This update expands the game’s long-term depth with the introduction of conference realignment, giving your league room to grow and evolve over time. The update also brings a number of new features, quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes and UI refinements. Changes listed below:



Major Features:

Conference realignment. Conferences will now shift and evolve over time with new teams rising up the ladder. Each offseason, you’ll have the option to manually realign teams across conferences. Additionally, conferences will automatically realign based on your selected frequency (automatic realignment can also be turned off if desired). You are also able to “lock” specific conferences to prevent them from gaining or losing teams during automatic realignment (accessed through the settings menu).

Prestige cap system. School prestige is now capped based on the prestige level of its conference.

New conference prestige recruit instance. Recruits now weigh the prestige of your conference when evaluating your program.

Neutral site tournament games. Conference and national tournament matchups now take place at neutral locations for added realism.

Recruiting class rankings and the conference that the team was in for a given season have been added to team history pages.

Conference & National Tournament Logos. Add conference logos to your logo packs by placing PNGs in a subfolder called “Conferences”. Name each file after its respective conference (e.g., Atlantic Coast Conference.png).To customize the national tournament court logo, add a PNG named National Tournament.png inside a new subfolder named “Misc”.




Bug Fixes & Tweaks:

Adjusted Top 25 ranking logic again to better emphasize team quality and schedule strength; rankings are now slightly “stickier” day-to-day and factor in net rating more heavily.

Fixed CT labels on the dashboard schedule when teams had a bye week.

Redshirt players now correctly count toward class totals in the "Team Needs" popup.

Fixed a bug where training progression wouldn’t save when injury rate was set to 0.

Safety checks have been added to handle post-season job offers more reliably and prevent a save-busting bug that would occur if you were fired and received no offers.

Fixed a bug where advancing a week could leave a previously injured player stuck in an injured state if you were viewing the rotation chart while advancing.

Fixed the school page schedule not updating when advancing weeks.

Various small UI/navigation improvements and polish.

notes.title: CLCB Update v0.2.0
notes.notes:
Hi all, the first update in the v0.2 phase (which will focus mainly on scheduling, realignment and long-term league progression) is here! The main addition is the ability to choose your non-conference opponents before the season begins. It also introduces tournament seed tracking in team history, as well as several performance and UI improvements/bug fixes. Changes listed below:

New Features & Improvements
- Players can now select their non-conference opponents before the season begins. Access this feature through the calendar button on the season preview page, or by clicking the schedule on the user school page. Changing your team’s non-conference schedule will impact the expected record for that season.
- National and conference tournament seed information is now saved to team history entries.

Bug Fixes & Tweaks
- Tournament bracket load times have been improved.
- Fixed a bug where player stats weren't resetting to page 1 after changing the conference filter.
- Improved performance of the custom logo feature, especially for large lists.
- When the recruit block opens, the scroll view now jumps to the top of the list of interested schools and adjusts height to match the number of offers.
- Clicking the settings button while the settings menu is already open now closes the menu.
- Improvements made to day-to-day simulation speeds, particularly for large leagues. The total average simulation time was reduced by roughly 15-20%.
- Fixed a bug where the user team’s national ranking on the main dashboard was occasionally lagging behind the actual ranking.
- Made adjustments to the national ranking logic to make rankings stickier and fixed some faulty logic which would occasionally cause teams to jump significantly in rank after a close loss to a strong opponent.

notes.title: CLCB Update v0.1.5
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, got another content update for you. This one adds several highly requested quality-of-life improvements and a new preferences/settings panel with a wide range of sim sliders. Full list of changes below:

New Features & Improvements
- You can now see why a player is transferring and attempt to convince them to stay (odds of convincing a player are based on their transfer desire score).
- A number of new settings and sliders have been added, giving players more control over the game sim and league rules (more will be added as we approach full release, so make sure to suggest settings/sliders you’d like to be included!). Sliders added include: shot type tendencies and accuracy, foul rates, assist rate, block rate, turnover rate, steal rate, home court advantage intensity, FT accuracy, offensive rebound rate, offensive priority impact, player progression rate, injury frequency, and transfer likelihood.
- The bracket UI has been upgraded with several improvements. Gameblocks now feature a cleaner layout and display each team’s logo. Clicking on a bracket block of a played game will now take you to the game log for that matchup. Additionally, your team is now highlighted in the CT/NT bracket view to make tracking your progress through the tournament easier.
- You can now filter player and team stats and coach/staff movements by conference.
- Added tracking for historical conference and national tournament brackets, accessible through the league history page. The individual game logs for these tournaments are not currently saved but that is probably something I’m going to allow the player to turn on in the future.
- Added plus-minus (+/-) stat to the school page player stats view.
- Added attribute-based sorting to the Roster and Redshirt Players pages. You can now sort players by year, position, height, weight, and all skill ratings for easier comparison.

Bug Fixes & Tweaks
- Fixed a bug where some characters in international surnames would display as blank.
- The Players Leaving panel is now sorted to show transfers first.
- Fixed a bug where user coach slider values (pace and focus) would occasionally reset when closing and reopening a save. 
- Recruiting logic has been adjusted slightly to reduce the chance of top schools hoarding too many 5-star prospects.

I’m planning for the next few updates to focus on expanded scheduling logic, conference realignment, and the long-term team progression “ecosystem,” among other things. Thanks, as always, for all the support and feedback!

notes.title: CLCB Update v0.1.4 Patch 5
notes.notes:
Another small patch today focused on safeguarding against some rare file corruption issues and an award filtering bug that popped up recently. Full list of changes below:

Bug Fixes & Tweaks:

- Added safeguards against corrupted media member records.
- Fixed an issue where conference awards and (on some occasions) the NPOTY block were not populating correctly.

notes.title: CLCB Update v0.1.4 Patch 4
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, quick patch today with a handful of bug fixes and performance improvements. Full list of changes below:

Bug Fixes & Tweaks:
- Made some improvements to day-to-day simulation speed.
- Further adjusted expected record logic to ensure that high-prestige teams are penalized for bad seasons.
- Made head coaches less likely to leave for another school after just one year at a new job.
- Added safeguards against a rare bug that could cause rosters to be cleared following an injury (unable to replicate this, let me know if it is still an issue for anyone).
- Fixed an issue where conference game replays weren’t correctly switching home/away status in 18-team conferences.

notes.title: Price Update Incoming + What's Next
notes.notes:
Hi all,

I wanted to give everyone a quick heads-up that the price of Campus Legends College Basketball will be increasing from $3.99 to $4.99 with the next content update, v0.1.5, which should be coming up in the next few weeks. I haven’t pinned down an exact date yet, but it will probably be toward the beginning of May.

The game has come a long way since the Early Access launch at the end of January. Some of the highlights include:

 Better manual minute allocation and new settings to better control the auto-allocation of minutes.
 Big improvements to the national ranking and tournament seeding logic, including more weight on quality wins and better placement logic.
 Support for custom leagues of any size between 64 and 368 teams, with flexible conference sizes and structure.
 Custom logo support, including in-game options for applying new logo packs at any time.
 Redshirt players.
 Major quality-of-life improvements to the recruiting system, including new filters, more information, better performance, and smarter AI.
 More polished systems overall, including updates to transfer logic, draft declaration, and rotation preferences.
 Better scheduling logic, including home/away balancing, realistic bracket layouts for custom leagues.
 Many, many bug fixes and balance tweaks, stability has improved considerably from the dark early days.

I've decided to slightly increase the price to better reflect the value of the game in its current state and help support its continued development. That said, I still want CLCB to continue to be as budget-friendly as possible. I plan to stick with the new $4.99 price point for a while and reevaluate only after more substantial content is added.

Looking ahead, the next update will focus on further quality-of-life improvements and deeper league customization options. After that, I’m planning to focus on version 0.2, which will center around scheduling and various highly requested features like conference realignment.

Thank you all again for all of the continued support, it has truly blown away my expectations. Your enthusiasm and feedback is what keeps me motivated to make this game the best that it can be.

notes.title: CLCB Update v0.1.4 Patch 3
notes.notes:
Alright, one last patch before the weekend, fixed a couple of small visual bugs and snuck in a minor content update (realistic jersey numbers). Changes below:

Features Added:
- Realistic jersey numbers by position (based on real-world roster data for the 24-25 season).

Bug Fixes & Tweaks:
- Conference name spacing has been adjusted to properly fit long conference names in the watch/sim game popup.
- Resolved an issue where custom logos in the conference standings section would temporarily disappear after returning from a watch game.
- Fixed a bug where team info was incorrectly flipped during some tournament watch games.

notes.title: CLCB Update v0.1.4 Patch 2
notes.notes:
Hey everybody, another patch as we head into final four weekend! This patch includes a handful of gameplay realism tweaks, memory optimizations (especially for custom logos), and quality-of-life improvements.

Bug Fixes & Tweaks
- Fixed a bug where offensive rebounds weren’t showing up correctly on the in-game box score page.
- Lowered the shooting foul and block rates for 3-pointers and midrange shots, and improved foul-drawing logic for strong scorers to better reflect real-life tendencies.
- Made custom logos on the CourtCast screen more memory efficient.
- Significant memory usage improvements, especially for users utilizing custom logos.
- Added national rank display for top 25 teams next to the team name on the School Overview page.
- Added the focus team’s rank or seed (at the time the game was played) to each matchup listed on the Team Schedule page.
- Fixed an issue where the wrong logo could appear at halfcourt during tournament games (though the correct team still received home court advantage).

notes.title: CLCB Update v0.1.4 Patch 1
notes.notes:
A few bug fixes focused on polishing up the new redshirt system and resolving lingering issues with conference scheduling logic.

Bug Fixes & Tweaks
- Cleaned up remaining issues with home/away splits for certain conference sizes. All in-conference matchups should now correctly alternate home and away games.
- Fixed a super senior bug that was preventing redshirt seniors from graduating as intended.
- Non-redshirted players who don't appear in any games throughout the season are now automatically granted redshirt status at the end of the year.
- Redshirt status now displays next to player names on both the Players Leaving and Cut Players screens.

notes.title: CLCB Update v0.1.4
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, got another content update for you which introduces a few highly-anticipated features (custom logo support and redshirts) along with a couple of bug fixes. Changes listed below:

Features Added
- Added custom logo support. To use this feature, you'll need a folder with two subfolders "ProTeams" and "Teams", place .png image files labeled with the team abbreviation (e.g., NYK.png, UNC.png) within these subfolders. The abbreviation must match the team's abbreviation in-game for the logo to display correctly. Logos should be in PNG format, ideally square and at least 256x256 pixels for best results. For new saves you will have the opportunity to select the logo pack when creating the save, for existing saves you can select a logo pack through the options menu.
- You can now redshirt players. You can redshirt a player at any point during the season (via the Training > Redshirts page), as long as they haven’t appeared in any games.
- Added sort-by buttons for Head Coach (HC), Assistant Coach (AC), or Graduate Assistant (GA) in relevant staff views.

Bug Fixes & Tweaks
- Fixed a bug where conference games were sometimes home/home or away/away series. Teams should now correctly play one home and one away game when facing an opponent twice in conference.
- Bracket display improvements: CT/NT brackets now keep teams in their correct visual position based on bracket flow instead of reordering by seed each round.
- Fixed an issue where conference tournament games weren’t always appearing on team schedule pages.
- Fixed blocked shot miss markers showing on the wrong side of the court.
- Fixed a bug where League History showed the wrong class year for National Player of the Year award winners.
- You can now click on player names on the Cut Players page to be taken to that player’s overview page.
- Fixed a bug where attendance wasn't correctly recorded for user team tournament games.
- Refined the player transfer logic to give potential transfers a better idea of their expected playing time in the upcoming season.
- Made balance adjustments to award voting - made team success slightly less impactful and made the national awards slightly favor players from high prestige conferences.
- Adjusted the expected record formula to factor in prestige more to help balance long-term prestige shifts.

As always, appreciate the feedback and bug reports!

notes.title: CLCB Update v0.1.3 Patch 4
notes.notes:
Quick patch knocking out a few bugs that have been pointed out to me today. I've got a list of little bugs and tweaks I still need to get through by this weekend and I'm making good progress on the upcoming content update. Changes listed below:

Bug Fixes & Tweaks
- Fixed a rare bug that occasionally caused freshman classes to come in as sophomores.   
- The "year" label at the top of a custom database now correctly determines the start year of the save.
- Fixed a bug that was causing head coach records to be tracked incorrectly if they left their original school.
- Added additional protections against the alumni record-clearing bug (can't replicate this so please let me know if it is still happening for anyone).

notes.title: CLCB Update v0.1.3 Patch 3
notes.notes:
Hey guys, shoutout to everyone who has started playing the game in the last couple of days, hope you have been enjoying your time with it so far. Quick patch here focused on improving usability, clarity, and background system performance.

Bug Fixes & Tweaks
- Added a warning at the start of recruiting week one if you haven’t spent all of your points. The game also now redirects you to the recruiting screen at the start of recruiting.
- Adjusted initial head coach generation to reduce the number of coaches aged 65+ at the start of new saves. Coach ages should now be more realistic.
- Base injury rate decreased slightly (again).
- Improved roster minimum verification efficiency and processing speed.
- Changed the way injury icons are displayed next to player names to reduce clutter and provide an indication of severity based on icon color.
- Team points per game are now correctly sorted by per game value, not total, on the team stats page.
- Fixed a bug where rotations to occasionally be regenerated upon injury even when set to manual. (Can't fully replicate, let me know if anyone is still having an issue with this.)
- Staff movement panel now displays head coach movement at the top of the table. (More improvements to this are coming in the next couple of patches/updates).

notes.title: CLCB Update v0.1.3 Patch 2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, I hope your brackets aren't as busted as mine already are, regardless, here is a small patch to help alleviate some commonly reported issues, changes listed below:

Bug Fixes & Tweaks
- Fixed a bug that was keeping stop sim on injury from working correctly.
- Added additional safeguards to hopefully prevent the alumni player records from being cleared incorrectly. This one is difficult to fully replicate so let me know if it still an issue for anyone.
- Added additional minimum player verification safeguards.

notes.title: CLCB Update v0.1.3 Patch 1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, another patch out today to address a couple of bug fixes and balancing adjustments based on recent feedback:

Bug Fixes & Tweaks
- Adjusted expectations logic to factor in the actual number of games played by a team.
- National tournament victories now impact prestige more (especially for low-prestige schools).
- Increased shot accuracy across the board to balance recent player rating adjustments, which had slightly reduced shooting effectiveness.
- Fixed a scheduling bug that caused conferences with an odd number of teams to play fewer conference games than intended.
- Resolved an issue where teams that committed offensive fouls would sometimes retain possession incorrectly.
- Fixed a bug with shooting stats, where missed shots due to fouls were occasionally incorrectly counted against a player's shooting percentage.
- Slightly lowered base injury rates.
- Fixed a rare save-stalling bug that occurred when teams dropped below six active players due to injury. The game will now automatically add walk-ons to meet the minimum threshold.
- Improved player page load times, especially in large leagues.
- Incremental improvements to memory overhead.

notes.title: CLCB Update v0.1.3
notes.notes:
Hi all, got another update for you, this one is primarily focused on improvements to recruiting, a few UI enhancements, and some key bug fixes. See the full list of changes below:

New Features & Improvements
- Added international recruits from a number of recruit-producing countries.
- Introduced base-level support for custom recruit hometown generation logic. (See locationWeights json in the LeagueData folder.)
- Each recruiting class will now have a handful of elite players who are notably better than the rest.
- Added a map to make sorting recruits by hometown easier.
- When a player commits, their numerical ratings will now be shown instead of letter grades.
- Added a new stats panel in the dropdown for transfer players on the recruiting page.
- Clicking on a team's recruiting class ranking entry now shows their recruiting class.
- Added a new filtering feature that allows selecting all uncommitted recruits at once, rather than filtering by a specific commit status.
- Clicking on the names of top players and teams in the season preview page now takes you to their respective pages.

Bug Fixes & Tweaks
- Fixed conference tournament results being recorded incorrectly in team history or coach experience records (most cases resolved, unable to fully replicate).
- Players' lineup changes now save when switching to the gameplan screen.
- Fixed missing apostrophes around coach comments in team streak article.
- Fixed an issue where the main recruiting page was not creating a navigation stack entry.
- Resolved a rare bug where the game could get stuck while calculating awards if a player didn’t meet the minimum criteria.
- Fixed occasional null returns when searching for transfer players.
- Resolved a bug that was, on rare occasions, causing the game to freeze while calculating all-conference teams.
- Blocked shots will now correctly appear as misses on the shot chart.
- Adjusted recruit/player generation to make classes less deep and potential ratings less random.
- Improved recruit filtering speeds.
- Tweaked CPU recruiting logic to make AI teams more aggressively pursue underrecruited prospects and value potential more.
- High-level recruits now won’t commit early to teams that don’t meet their prestige requirements, making it harder to poach underrecruited top players.
- Adjusted player development to weigh coach/assistant ratings more heavily.
- You can now click on player names on the players leaving page and on the recruiting page (only for transfer players) to open their player overview.
- Fixed a bug with playing time interest that was incorrectly causing most players to receive low grades.
- Reduced the number of players who declare for the draft each year only to go undrafted.

notes.title: CLCB Update v0.1.2 Patch 3
notes.notes:
Another quick patch, I believe I've identified what was causing the incorrect minutes tracking some players were seeing. Thanks to everyone for playing and submitting feedback as always!

Bug Fixes & Tweaks
- Offer bonus will now still give points on offer if you don’t assign any points initially (previously wouldn’t give offer bonus until you added recruiting points).
- Made adjustments to foul trouble substitution logic and off-ball foul frequency to make it more forgiving/realistic.
- Fixed a bug that was occasionally causing alumni player records to be cleared.
- Fixed a rare bug that was occasionally causing players to show up as committing to a blank school instead of the user school.
- Fixed a bug with minutes calculation for extra possessions (occurring after an offensive rebound).

notes.title: CLCB Update v0.1.2 Patch 2
notes.notes:
Quick patch to address some recently reported bugs, changes listed below:

Bug Fixes & Tweaks
- Fixed an issue where players were occasionally listed as walk-ons even though they had been offered scholarships.
- Another fix attempted to eliminate the last few rare cases of the injury bug.
- The header button on a gameblock is now deactivated if the game is not a tournament game.
- CT results for 8-team tournaments were not recorded correctly; future results will now be properly recorded and displayed.
- Updated the settings/preferences icon.
- Fixed a bug where the game could get stuck while calculating initial interest for recruits.
- Fixed a bug where some players were unable to see draft results due to date parsing errors.

notes.title: CLCB Update v0.1.2 Patch 1
notes.notes:
Hi all, hope you have been having fun with the new update. This patch deals with a couple of improvements, tweaks and bug fixes based on feedback since the update came out:

Bug Fixes & Tweaks
- Fixed an issue where high-tier recruits were not being picky enough about school prestige following the most recent updates to initial interest logic.
- Sim to conference games option now working properly for all conference sizes (previously it would just take you to game 16).
- Fixed a bug causing some teams in 16-team conferences to play 19 conference games in a season rather than 20.
- Fixed an issue where conference standings were not properly sorting by conference games until game 16.
- Shooting logs are now split into two parts: one for the shot attempt and one for the result, improving clarity in the play log.
- Pro Draft order is now correctly randomized each year.
- Fixed an issue with CPU team rotation logic which was, on occasion, incorrectly starting lower-rated players over more deserving players at the same position.
- Fixed a bug within the game sim that was causing fouling teams to occasionally win possession after committing a defensive foul.
- Fixed uninterested recruits not displaying factor grades correctly.
- Additional adjustments to try and ensure even the worst teams have a good number of recruits interested in their program initially.

notes.title: CLCB Update v0.1.2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, new update for you today. Most significant new feature is the ability to create custom leagues of any size between 64 and 368 teams. Conferences are limited to any size between 8 and 18. This feature is still in an “experimental” phase as I haven’t been able to playtest much yet so you may run into additional bugs and performance issues if you play with a custom league outside the default 192 team parameters. Lots of other tweaks and bug fixes as well, all changes listed below:

New Features & Improvements
- Rankings now weigh net rating more heavily for smoother adjustments and more realistic season-long rankings.
- National rankings are now shown on the conference standings panel on the main dashboard.
- Added new tournament structures to accommodate different league formats.
- Players can now create leagues of any size between 64 and 368 teams (still experimental).
- The conference tournament bracket page will now remember the last viewed bracket when navigating away.
- Conference schedules now better reflect real-life structures with more conference games per year.
- Clicking on an opponent team name on the school schedule page now directs you to their team page.
- Added a confirmation prompt when attempting to advance with unspent coach points.

Balance Tweaks
- Bench warmers (players with 0 minutes allocated) will only play if needed in a blowout situation, while bench players with minutes assigned will now correctly be prioritized.
- Adjusted the balance of initial recruit interest levels and importance factors for more realistic recruiting battles.
- Contested inside shot success now scales more with height, giving tall players more of a bonus and short players more of a penalty.
- Further adjustments made to balance training progression.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where click location on the team selection and team schedule pages occasionally didn’t match the cursor position.
- Addressed an issue where league news was occasionally failing to refresh properly day-to-day.
- Fixed an issue where player stats sometimes wouldn't reload until checking team stats first.
- The conference tournament bracket page now updates correctly when viewed while simulating games.
- Addressed a bug where alumni player records were incorrectly being cleared.
- Historical draft result articles (when accessed from the league news hub) now correctly populate immediately after the draft instead of after recruiting begins.
- Further adjusted draft logic to prevent unqualified players from being selected, more weight given to stats.
- Made another attempt to fix the bug where injuries aren’t being saved correctly (still can’t replicate).

notes.title: CLCB v0.1.1 Patch 2
notes.notes:
Another quick patch to fix a few bugs/balance issues with the new update, changes listed below:

Bug Fixes/Improvements:
- Fixed a bug that occasionally allowed injured players to play as if they were uninjured.
- Further balance tweaks to the POTY, and national first/second-team awards.
- Fixed a bug that occasionally kept players from assigning forced starters if the starters from the previous season left the school.

notes.title: CLCB Update v0.1.1 Patch 1
notes.notes:
Quick patch to address a couple of issues with the new update, changes below:

Bug Fixes/Improvements:
- Fixed team records on schedule game objects not updating during tournaments.
- Adjusted award logic to reduce over-representation of guards.
- Fixed issues with new national tournament seeding logic to ensure more accurate and realistic placement.
- Further tweaks to national ranking logic (valuing strength of victories/losses more)

Thank you guys for the continued feedback!

notes.title: CLCB Update v0.1.1
notes.notes:
Hi all, hope you've been enjoying v0.1 of the game so far! This update includes various improvements, new features and bug fixes (detailed below). Key additions include better manual minute allocation and new settings to better control the auto allocation of minutes. I also made a few balance changes to shot-making variance and improved national ranking/tournament seeding logic.

New Features/Improvements
- Minutes are no longer automatically reallocated when removed from a player; they are instead banked.
- New auto-rotation settings, including preferred composition, forced starters, starter minutes preference, and bench size.
- The schedule game blocks now display team records for unplayed games.
- Clicking the CT/NT header at the top of a schedule game block will take you to the tournament bracket.
- School page schedules now show the ranking/seeds of opponents.
- New option to enable the right-click action to "undo" (navigation).
- Added a setting to stop multi-week sims when injuries occur.
- Player scoring ratings are now displayed on the offensive priority screen.
- CPU rotation logic now favors the best players slightly more.
- Added summary offense, defense and scoring ratings to the rotation panel.
- Players returning from injury now provide notifications.

Balance Tweaks:
- Adjusted shot-making logic to reduce variance and make results more consistent with player ratings.
- Tweaked National Ranking & Tournament Seeding Logic to place greater emphasis on high-quality wins, prior ranking, and team strength.
- Toned down draft declarations for players who aren't playing enough to warrant being drafted.
- Toned down training development some.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug where #16 seeds were incorrectly given home-court advantage in conference tournaments.
- Fixed a bug that was causing conference tournament seeding to be based on the results of the second to last day's standings rather than the last.
- Adjusted recruiting class generation logic to better support custom databases (Work in progress).
- Fixed issue where week 1 training reports would occasionally generate multiple times.
- Season review awards now correctly show the team and year the player was on when they won, rather than their final year.
- Fixed an issue where player page heights occasionally did not scale correctly for players with many awards.
- Fixed minor visual bug with user highlight on the Coach of the Year award being too bright.
- Fixed Wichita team name typo in the default database.
- Fixed a bug causing teams to skip regular season games on rare occasions (might still be an issue haven't been able replicate this)

notes.title: CLCB v0.1 Patch 3
notes.notes:
Hi all, one last patch to close out the weekend, this one's a bit smaller. List of changes below:

Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where overall ratings were not recalculating correctly after training.
- Award parameters have been adjusted to prevent occasional blocks when advancing to the offseason.
- Fixed a display issue where 2020 articles were incorrectly appearing above 2030+ articles in the news hub.
- Fixed bug causing the previous game field in the national rankings page to appear incorrectly.
- Resolved overlapping text in All-Conference and All-National award displays.
- Resolved previous draft results being overwritten.
- Draft results button on the players leaving page now correctly directs to the right draft after 2029.

notes.title: CLCB v0.1 Patch 2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, another big patch coming in, hopefully this will clean up a lot of the stuff reported so far. Below is a list of everything that's changing:

Bug Fixes
- Exiting the game during game creation won't create corrupted save files now.
- Fixed an issue where the save state year in the load games menu was incorrect.
- Tournament participation is now correctly displayed in team history for past seasons.
- Fixed a scheduling issue some users were facing where they were unable to advance past November 7 in a long-term sim. (This should fix the bug for saves that were previously affected as well as prevent it in new saves).
- Search results and school page coach/staff info now update properly after coach hiring/firings.
- Addressed a bug where play-by-play could show a player fouling out twice and being subbed in twice.
- Games should now properly clear previous game stats, hopefully preventing inaccurate box scores where it says teams score 150+ points (haven't been able to recreate this one, might still be an issue).
- Fixed an issue where changes to the offensive priority rating were incorrectly affecting overall rating calculation.
- Fixed a UI scaling bug with the start menu at 1280x720 resolution.
- Potential fix for articles in the news hub stopping after the 2029 season (unable to fully replicate).
- Potentially fixed all-conference/all-national awards not populating correctly (can't fully replicate).

Improvements
- Adjusted bodyweight for generated players to be more realistic.
- Made reason for leaving UI easier to read.
- Added database error checks to prevent duplicate team abbreviations.
- Custom databases manually placed in the folder now undergo error checks before being loaded.
- Improved shot-taking tendency logic to better reflect real-life positional scoring.
- Adjusted sim stat balance for offensive rebounds, turnovers, fouls, points, and more.
- Improved how game time advances after an offensive rebound to better match real-life pacing.

notes.title: CLCB v0.1 Patch 1
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where transferring to coach at a new school occasionally still left the user coaching for their previous school in the offseason.
- Clicking on a player from the game log page or key players list now loads their profile much faster.
- Fixed a bug where National Title Count in League History wasn’t increasing properly.
- Resolved an issue where firing assistants and hiring new staff prevented the user from firing the old staff, but still allowed firing the newly hired ones.
- CourtCast playback speed now correctly matches the bar slider’s initial value on start.
- Fixed an issue where filters wouldn't apply when closing the filter panel using the filter icon.
- Resolved an overlapping text issue when updating the all-freshman team’s first entry.
- Navigating to a player's profile from the Gameplan page and then using the back button now correctly returns the user to the Gameplan page.

Improvements
- Recruiting filter load times have been sped up somewhat, further improvements on the way.
- Players who receive an offer will now automatically be marked as "targeted" if the user has a target to use making it easier to track them in recruiting.
